# ReentrantTransition

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A phase transition where a system returns to a previously observed phase as a control parameter is varied further, indicating non-monotonic phase boundaries. Reveals complex phase diagrams that can inform robust state control and switching mechanisms in neuromorphic or topological circuits.
